answer: Give every identity a small ember of trust that can only grow into a kernel of standing through licensed work: bind each agent to one public professional license, such as a radio callsign or notary commission, verified against the issuing registry, with the license number published on-ledger. A falcon audit team re-checks a random slice each epoch and revokes any identity whose license lapsed or was shared. Forging one means passing an in-person exam and paying its fee; forging a thousand means a thousand exams, fees, and faces in exam halls, while honest agents pay once and keep working.
